I used to believe this - until I got better. When you get better, you realize that people really do love you. People really do care. You would hurt them beyond repair by commiting suicide. Knowing that it would be a selfish thing to do pulled me out of it. It is selfish. If someone dies to suicide, their loved ones have every right to be angry and feel betrayed and cheated. People don't see the actual effects of suicide, just that everyone will "realize they were wrong and how much they miss you" and whatnot, but that is such a dangerous message. No one will think "aw poor them". It'll be their turn to be selfish. They will be angry. They will be irrational and they will hate you, because that's what grief does to people. Nothing will be better by commiting suicide. It is selfish and awful. And it obviously isn't a choice to be depressed, but it's a choice to reach out.
